name: ExtractTextFromDocxFile
label: Extract text from DOCX file
description: Reads text content from a .docx document using Open XML SDK.

fields.name: DocumentPath
fields.label: Document Path
fields.description: The full file path to the .docx document to read from.

fields.name: Retrieve
fields.label: Retrieve
fields.description: Specifies the portion of the document to retrieve.

selectOptions.label: Whole Document
selectOptions.description: Retrieves the entire content of the document.

selectOptions.label: Pages
selectOptions.description: Retrieves content based on specified page numbers.

selectOptions.label: Bookmark
selectOptions.description: Retrieves content located within a specific bookmark.

fields.name: BookmarkName
fields.label: Bookmark Name
fields.description: The name of the bookmark to retrieve content from.

fields.name: WordData
fields.label: Word Data
fields.description: The value of the retrieved content.
